columns.name: APPLICANT_SCORE_ID
columns.description: A unique key generated by system for each row that acts as a Primary Key for the table

columns.name: ENTITY_TYPE
columns.description: Stores the context ORA_SUBMISSION or ORA_PROSPECT.

columns.name: REQUISITION_ID
columns.description: Requisition id of the respective submission/prospect. Foreign key to irc_requisitions_b table.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Candidate person id of the submission/prospect. Foreign key to per_persons table.

columns.name: PROFILE_AI_SCORE
columns.description: Matching profile score of the candidate for the given requisition.

columns.name: EXPERIENCE_AI_SCORE
columns.description: Matching Experience score of the candidate for the given requisition.

columns.name: EDUCATION_AI_SCORE
columns.description: Matching Education score of the candidate for the given requisition.

columns.name: SKILLS_AI_SCORE
columns.description: Matching Skills score of the candidate for the given requisition.

columns.name: OVERALL_SCORE
columns.description: Overall matching score of the candidate for the given requisition.

columns.name: PROFILE_SUMMARY
columns.description: Matching profile summary of the candidate for the given requisition.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
